description: TEMPLATE ONLY — copy to a local file (e.g. live_oracle.local.json, gitignored) before enabling cases. Curate ITAA 1936 / 1953 / 1997 + ATO TD / PG / PR questions against a real LightRAG index. Strings in expected_sections, expected_chunk_contains, and expected_sources MUST match indexed chunk text after reconciliation on the WebUI or POST /query/data (content + content_headings + file_path). Do not paste statute book wording that never survived ingest/chunking. All example shells ship with enabled=false; the fitness runner skips disabled cases. Empty pgs/prs arrays are valid when that instrument type is not required for the case.

cases.question: REPLACE: When can a taxpayer claim a general deduction under ITAA 1997 s 8-1?
expected_sections: REPLACE: heading text as it appears in content_headings / chunk body after ingest
expected_chunk_contains: REPLACE: distinctive phrase from the indexed s 8-1 chunk
forbidden_chunk_contains: REPLACE: trap keyword that appears in penalties / unrelated Parts mentioning deduction

cases.question: REPLACE: Does an ATO TD confirm how 'to the extent' in s 8-1 requires apportionment?

acts: REPLACE: Act filename or section string seen in /query/data
tds: REPLACE: TD filename or TD YYYY/N string seen in /query/data
